build.energy_regen_target: around 140% Energy Regen (Game8's stated target for an effective sub-DPS rotation)
build.fast_path: Fast path: Emerald of Genesis + 5-piece Moonlit Clouds in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Bell-Borne Geochelone in the main slot. Aim for ~140% Energy Regen first, then Crit Rate/Crit DMG; Aero DMG on the 3-costs and ATK% on the 1-costs. Swap in, cast Liberation to group enemies, Outro to feed energy, swap out.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: Game8's best weapon for Yangyang: Crit Rate substat plus 12.8% Energy Regen from the passive, which gets her to her ~140% ER target easily.

ranked_weapons.note: Premium 5-star alternative with high ATK and general buffs; strong but not hers.

stat_priorities.note: Crit main stat; pick the one that balances her 1:2 ratio.

profile.role_note: Free early-game energy battery and grouper; her Outro restores Resonance Energy to the incoming character, and her S6 adds a team-wide ATK buff.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Free from the story, so never pull for her — but she's a genuinely useful account tool: a fast energy funnel for liberation-hungry carries like Jiyan and Spectro Rover. Keep expectations modest; dedicated buffers outclass her damage contribution.

members.name: Jiyan
members.note: AoE carry; in his Liberation state every attack is a fast Heavy Attack and he is hungry for his Liberation every rotation.

members.name: Yangyang
members.note: Few-second on-field time: groups enemies with her Liberation, then Outros to hand Jiyan energy.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Heals and grants Crit Rate/Crit DMG inside her Stellarealm; documented support option for Yangyang teams.

teams.name: Premium: Jiyan + Yangyang + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Shorekeeper sets up her Stellarealm, Yangyang drops her Liberation to group enemies and a quick Resonance Skill, then Outros into Jiyan — her energy refund plus Shorekeeper's buffs let Jiyan enter his Liberation state on schedule.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: Takes the on-field carry slot in this free early-game team; their Liberation is the payoff Yangyang's energy feeds.

members.name: Yangyang
members.note: Charges Concerto fast, groups small enemies, and Outros energy into the Rover.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Universal healer/buffer; documented support option whose Outro deepens team damage.

teams.name: Budget: Spectro Rover + Yangyang + Verina
teams.rotation: Yangyang opens, builds Concerto with her fast combo, casts Liberation to group enemies, then Outros — the energy refund lands on Spectro Rover, who follows with Intro into their Liberation; Verina heals and buffs between rotations.
